import java.util.*;

public class Main {

    public static void main(String args[]){
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int base = scanner.nextInt(), number = scanner.nextInt();
        int digits[] = new int[101];

        for(int i=0; i<=100; i++){
            digits[i] = number % base;
            number /= base;
        }

        int carry = 0;
        boolean isValid = true;
        for(int i=0; i<=100; i++){
            digits[i] += carry;
            carry = digits[i] / base;
            digits[i] %= base;

            if(digits[i] == 0 || digits[i] == 1){
                continue;
            } else if(digits[i] == base - 1){
                carry = 1;
            } else {
                isValid = false;
                break;
            }
        }

        System.out.print((isValid && carry != 1) ? "YES" : "NO");
    }
}
